skills.name: Thief Transformation
skills.description: Jessica transforms into a thief. Good effects on allies.  *Skill Resistance +40% (10 sec) *Move Speed +130% (10 sec)

skills.name: Crossbow Firing
skills.description: Attacks enemies by firing the crossbow in rapid succession. Bad effects on enemies.  *Cancels enemy invincibility skills  *Cancels enemy buffs   *ATK x 3200% Area Damage  *Enemy knockback

abilities.name: Gas Mask
abilities.description: Rangers with this Ability won't take damage in advent stages  with the Poison Gas obstacle effect.

abilities.name: Deploy Knockback: Strength
abilities.description: Has a high chance of knocking back all Strength type enemies and canceling their invincibility skill effects when Rangers deploy. - Activates 5 seconds after battles start. - You must wait 6 seconds before you can use an Ability again after using one with the same effect on the same type of Ranger. - Bosses, Guardians, and special type enemies are not affected by this Ability.
